name: Severstal: Steel Defect Detection
description: Production-line flat sheet steel surface defect classification and segmentation benchmark consisting of 18,074 high-frequency camera images (1600x256 resolution) capturing sheet steel surfaces during active rolling. Features pixel-level run-length encoded annotations across four surface defect classes (pitted surface, crazing, scratches, and patches) alongside flawless surface regions.
